title: Woman in Coat and Glasses, 1940s B&W Snapshot Portrait, 1947
description: A black and white outdoor snapshot portrait from June 1947 showing a woman standing near a low brick wall. She is wearing round eyeglasses, a thick winter overcoat featuring large circular buttons, and her hair is coiffed in a classic mid-1940s curled style. The back of the photo features a stamp reading '558E' and a handwritten note in pink ink indicating 'June-47'.
